title: Crohn's disease healed after the 2007 orb encounter
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Crohn's disease healed after the 2007 orb encounter, about 2007 at North Carolina, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then my Crohn's was gone. I had no [music] more sickness.
Because on the one hand you were cured of Crohn's disease
tellings.difference: Told by the host rather than by Chris, and puts the event in January 2007.
tellings.link_reason: Both say Chris's Crohn's disease was cured after the 2007 encounter in North Carolina. The missing-time story is a wider account of the whole night.

as_told.title: Chris cured of Crohn's disease after the January 2007 event

plain: A man in North Carolina named Chris Bledsoe says he had an encounter in 2007 with orbs, glowing balls of light. Before that, he says, he suffered from Crohn's disease, a long-lasting and painful illness of the gut. Bledsoe says that after the encounter his Crohn's was gone and he had no more sickness. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, repeats this in conversation with him, saying Bledsoe was cured of the disease. Michels places the encounter in January 2007. So Bledsoe gives it firsthand and the host retells it back to him, and if it is true, contact with these lights healed a man's illness.
